sources.title: Cognition Devin: Code Scans (Sep 16)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Cognition Sep 16 launches Devin Code Scans (/scan entry; docs linked): goal-to-PR codebase investigations via Agentic MapReduce (Plan/Shard/Map/Reduce with completeness property that every selected batch is processed); scan catalog spans performance, queries, coverage, dead code, quality, telemetry, accessibility, compliance, migration, SEO, custom.
claims.context: Feature and architecture sections as stated.

claims.text: Philips pilot: 96% PR merge rate, 700+ engineering hours saved. Worked examples: Dioxus compile scan 58.6s->21.0s (-64%, 22 crates); devin.ai/cognition.com SEO scan (Ahrefs 87->92, slow pages -73%, alt text eliminated).
claims.context: Customer/example sections as stated; pilot outcomes vendor-reported.

limitations.text: Architecture is vendor-described design; no independent benchmark of investigation quality/completeness.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
